_labeling_rules: A task is an explicit commitment ('will', 'I'll', 'should' + task). 'might look at' is not a commitment.
owner is the project-directory id, or null when nobody, an unknown person, or more than one person is named.
due_date is the true calendar date (meeting 2026-10-08 is a Thursday), even where the deterministic parser cannot resolve it (L7 'tomorrow').
validation is what the system rules SHOULD output: FLAG for unresolved owner/date or a likely duplicate.
